mapper.insert: insert into batch.scheduled_occurrence_fire (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, scheduled_fire_time, fire_instance_id, refire_count, actual_fire_time, fire_kind) values (#{tenantId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{scheduledFireTime}, #{fireInstanceId}, #{refireCount}, #{actualFireTime}, #{fireKind}) on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, scheduled_fire_time, fire_instance_id, refire_count) do nothing
mapper.select: select schedule_version, calendar_code, biz_date, occurrence_status, request_id from batch.scheduled_occurrence where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_definition_id = #{workflowDefinitionId} and scheduled_fire_time = #{scheduledFireTime} and occurrence_status != 'PLANNED'
mapper.insert: insert into batch.scheduled_occurrence ( tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, workflow_code, schedule_version, calendar_code, scheduled_fire_time, biz_date, occurrence_status, request_id, misfire_detected_at ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{workflowCode}, #{scheduleVersion}, #{calendarCode}, #{scheduledFireTime}, #{bizDate}, #{status}, #{requestId}, case when #{status} = 'MISFIRE_PENDING' then CURRENT_TIMESTAMP else null end ) on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, scheduled_fire_time) do update set schedule_version = case when batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = 'PLANNED' then greatest(batch.scheduled_occurrence.schedule_version, excluded.schedule_version) else batch.scheduled_occurrence.schedule_version end, calendar_code = case when batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = 'PLANNED' then excluded.calendar_code else batch.scheduled_occurrence.calendar_code end, biz_date = case when batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = 'PLANNED' then excluded.biz_date else batch.scheduled_occurrence.biz_date end, occurrence_status = excluded.occurrence_status, request_id = coalesce(batch.scheduled_occurrence.request_id, excluded.request_id), misfire_detected_at = coalesce(batch.scheduled_occurrence.misfire_detected_at, excluded.misfire_detected_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where ( batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status in ('PLANNED', 'WAITING_READINESS', 'MISFIRE_PENDING') or batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = excluded.occurrence_status or (batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = 'CLOSED_DAY_REJECTED' and excluded.occurrence_status in ('REQUESTED', 'MISFIRE_PENDING') and exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_request request where request.tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id and request.request_id = excluded.request_id and request.workflow_definition_id = excluded.workflow_definition_id and request.biz_date = excluded.biz_date and request.trigger_type = 'CATCH_UP' )) ) and (batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = 'PLANNED' or ( batch.scheduled_occurrence.schedule_version = excluded.schedule_version and batch.scheduled_occurrence.calendar_code is not distinct from excluded.calendar_code and batch.scheduled_occurrence.biz_date is not distinct from excluded.biz_date )) and (batch.scheduled_occurrence.request_id is null or batch.scheduled_occurrence.request_id = excluded.request_id)

insert into batch.scheduled_occurrence ( tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, workflow_code, schedule_version, calendar_code, scheduled_fire_time, biz_date, occurrence_status, last_rejection_reason ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{workflowCode}, #{scheduleVersion}, #{calendarCode}, #{scheduledFireTime}, #{bizDate}, #{status}, #{reason} ) on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, scheduled_fire_time) do update set biz_date = case when batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = 'PLANNED' then excluded.biz_date else batch.scheduled_occurrence.biz_date end, occurrence_status = excluded.occurrence_status, last_rejection_reason = excluded.last_rejection_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status in ('PLANNED', 'WAITING_READINESS', 'MISFIRE_PENDING') and batch.scheduled_occurrence.request_id is null

insert into batch.scheduled_occurrence ( tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, workflow_code, schedule_version, calendar_code, scheduled_fire_time, biz_date, occurrence_status ) values
(#{tenantId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{workflowCode}, #{scheduleVersion}, #{calendarCode}, #{fire.scheduledFireTime}, #{fire.bizDate}, #{targetStatus})
mapper.sql: on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, scheduled_fire_time) do update set schedule_version = excluded.schedule_version, calendar_code = excluded.calendar_code, biz_date = excluded.biz_date, occurrence_status = #{targetStatus}, readiness_deferred_since = null, readiness_deadline = null, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status in ('PLANNED', 'SUPERSEDED') and batch.scheduled_occurrence.schedule_version <= excluded.schedule_version and ( batch.scheduled_occurrence.occurrence_status = 'SUPERSEDED' or batch.scheduled_occurrence.schedule_version <> excluded.schedule_version or batch.scheduled_occurrence.calendar_code is distinct from excluded.calendar_code or batch.scheduled_occurrence.biz_date is distinct from excluded.biz_date )
mapper.select: select scheduled_fire_time from batch.scheduled_occurrence where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_definition_id = #{workflowDefinitionId} and occurrence_status = 'MISFIRE_PENDING' and not exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_misfire_pending pending where pending.tenant_id = batch.scheduled_occurrence.tenant_id and pending.workflow_definition_id = batch.scheduled_occurrence.workflow_definition_id and pending.scheduled_fire_time = batch.scheduled_occurrence.scheduled_fire_time and pending.status = 'PENDING' ) order by scheduled_fire_time limit #{limit}

select tenant_id as tenantId, workflow_definition_id as workflowDefinitionId, scheduled_fire_time as scheduledFireTime, readiness_deadline as deadline from batch.scheduled_occurrence where occurrence_status = 'WAITING_READINESS' and readiness_deadline <= #{now} order by readiness_deadline asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage ( tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, configuration_revision, schedule_version, calendar_code, coverage_from_at, coverage_through_at, last_success_at, updated_at ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{configurationRevision}, #{scheduleVersion}, #{calendarCode}, #{coverageFrom}, #{coverageThrough}, greatest(#{completedAt}, clock_timestamp()), greatest(#{completedAt}, clock_timestamp()) ) on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id) do update set schedule_version = excluded.schedule_version, configuration_revision = excluded.configuration_revision, calendar_code = excluded.calendar_code, coverage_from_at = case when excluded.schedule_version > batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.schedule_version or excluded.calendar_code is distinct from batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.calendar_code then excluded.coverage_from_at else least( batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.coverage_from_at, excluded.coverage_from_at) end, coverage_through_at = case when excluded.schedule_version > batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.schedule_version or excluded.calendar_code is distinct from batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.calendar_code or excluded.configuration_revision > batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.configuration_revision then excluded.coverage_through_at else greatest( batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.coverage_through_at, excluded.coverage_through_at) end, last_success_at = greatest( batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.last_success_at, excluded.last_success_at, clock_timestamp()), updated_at = greatest( batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.updated_at, excluded.updated_at, clock_timestamp()) where batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.schedule_version <= excluded.schedule_version and batch.scheduled_occurrence_coverage.configuration_revision <= excluded.configuration_revision
